dataset.name: esper-pdf
dataset.description: Fixed fictional digital PDF development benchmark: ten three-page PDFs, page-level relevance and one image-only page in a mixed PDF. Simple layouts; not representative of arbitrary real-world PDFs. Frozen before the first PDF benchmark run.

documents.extraction_warning: Pagine senza testo estraibile: 2. Ricerca parziale; eventuali scansioni richiedono OCR.
